question: What constitutes "closely associated with a word" for the purpose of this function?
answer: 'Closely associated with a word' means the character is immediately adjacent to (part of) an alphabetic sequence -- concretely: the last character is only True if it is alphabetic AND is not immediately preceded by another alphabetic character forming part of the same word (i.e. it must be a single-letter 'word' on its own, isolated by non-letter characters or string boundaries on both sides).
